name: content-snare-mcp
description: Work with Content Snare from Claude Code: clients, requests, templates, team members and webhooks through the Content Snare API.

api_token.title: Content Snare personal access token
api_token.description: Create one in Content Snare under Settings > Security > Personal Access Tokens. It starts with cs_pat_. Claude Code stores it in your system credential store, not in a settings file. Leave blank to set it up later.
